subtopicTitle: Particle in a box — solving TISE, energy levels, wavefunctions

cards.front: What is the potential V(x) for a 1D infinite square well of width L?
State the boundary conditions imposed on ψ(x).
cards.back: ψ(0)=ψ(L)=0 (continuity and vanishing at infinite walls).

cards.front: Write the TISE inside the well (V=0).
Derive allowed k values from boundary conditions.
cards.back: General solution: ψ=A sin(kx)+B cos(kx). ψ(0)=0⇒B=0. ψ(L)=0⇒sin(kL)=0⇒kL=nπ (n=1,2,…). Thus k_n=nπ/L.

cards.front: How many nodes does ψ_n(x) have inside (0,L)?

cards.back: ∫_0^L (2/L) sin²(nπx/L) dx = (2/L)×(L/2)=1 using the identity ∫sin²θ dθ over integer half-periods.
